verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents its own registered-agent service: it lists its address as your registered agent on public records and handles the switch paperwork with your Secretary of State. Nothing in the pack says that service is available in every US state, so the multi-state, single-vendor part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit all-50-state (plus DC) coverage claim, documentation of adding another state under the same account, and independent corroboration of multi-state coverage.

support.subject: As a founder, one provider covers registered-agent service in every US state, so registering in a new state does not mean finding a new vendor

citations.quote: Our address is listed as the registered agent on public records instead of yours, providing extra privacy
We'll also change the registered agent information with your Secretary of State.
